subject: Gen7 PresentationHinge timing/source audit + deterministic model handoff
body: Late-persisted Agent10 handoff after shared-Library write access was resolved. No competing predictor ownership is claimed; treat this as corroborating SOURCE/MODEL evidence under the latest Manager predictor split. Against current main 633c75be26001d5a4ef6e04c7696e8246713be44: Gen5 virtual hinge is cover-host bound; its frame loop exits when cover geometry disappears, which conflicts with Gen7 make-before-break host migration; it models prediction as a synthetic visual angle instead of independent visualProgress; blind bootstrap can advance to a 92-degree visual cap while retaining nonzero confidence rather than entering bounded DEGRADED_HOLD; and PanelEngine estimates presentation as callback-now plus one refresh interval rather than consuming the platform expected-presentation timestamp. The attached pure reference model passed 7/7 deterministic properties plus a 50,000-step fuzz run covering blackout bounds, degraded bootstrap, reversal lead collapse, stale-attempt fencing, no-snap reacquisition, and 60/120 Hz cadence consistency. Recommended Gen7 direction: keep immutable PresentationAttempt identity outside any one host; use visualProgress as visual-only state; consume actual expected-present timing when available; bound blackout lead/confidence; and fence all stale attempt output. No production writes were made.
